result.title: Spectral Considerations on Unsupervised Time-domain EEG Representation Learning with Deep Networks
result.summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive, scalable source of quantitative biomarkers for the early diagnosis of brain disorders, and deep representation learning has become a powerful paradigm for extracting information-rich latent features from raw signals. However, neural networks tend to under-represent high-frequency information, a concern that is especially acute for EEG given its oscillatory nature and characteristic $1/f^χ$ power decay, which risks masking disease-relevant high-frequency signatures. In this study, we systematically investigate the spectral constraints of unsupervised time-domain feature extraction across three autoencoder architectures (LSTMVAE, VAEEG, Transformer) and a state-of-the-art EEG foundation model. Using synthetic experiments and empirical validation, we show that while autoencoders capture macro-scale shifts such as alpha slowing, they remain biased against higher frequencies due to a magnitude-driven masking effect induced by the Mean Squared Error loss under 1/f-decaying spectra. Increasing latent dimensionality mitigates this attenuation but sacrifices latent compactness and generative stability. We argue that, as the field advances toward large-scale foundation-level feature extractors, it is imperative to move beyond simple time-domain reconstruction and to integrate spectral-domain loss terms and gradient-balancing techniques, so that the subtle high-frequency transients critical for diagnosing complex brain disorders are preserved in the latent representation.

AI.brief_summary: 该文系统研究无监督时域 EEG 表示学习中的频谱约束，比较 LSTMVAE、VAEEG、Transformer 及一个 EEG 基础模型，指出 MSE 重建损失在 1/f 谱下产生幅度驱动的掩蔽效应，使自编码器系统性地欠表示高频信息，并讨论潜在维度、紧凑性与生成稳定性之间的权衡。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属远领域信号处理，但其「潜在状态系统性丢失高频细节、增大维度只能以紧凑性换取保真」的机制，可能与 LVR 中视觉细节在 latent 中的信息坍缩问题形成类比，其频谱域损失与梯度平衡思路可供核查是否可迁移。
